units.source_text: 此次赴住吉还愿，对外不提起明石道人之意，但言源氏自己要去朝拜。

en.t: For this journey to Sumiyoshi to fulfill a vow, they did not mention the intention of the Akashi monk to outsiders, but said only that Genji himself was going to pay his respects.

units.source_text: 从前流亡须磨、明石诸浦时所许的愿，早已还清。

en.t: The vows he had made long ago while living in exile on the shores of Suma and Akashi had already been fully repaid.

units.source_text: 遇赦还都之后，又得在世长生，享受种种荣华，神佛呵护之恩不可忘记。

en.t: After receiving a pardon and returning to the capital, he had lived on for many years and enjoyed every kind of honor, so he could not forget the grace of the gods and Buddhas who had protected him.

units.source_text: 因此偕紫夫人同往，这消息便轰动一时。

en.t: For this reason he set out together with Lady Murasaki, and the news caused a great stir for a time.

units.source_text: 源氏为欲避免打扰臣民，万事力求简省。

en.t: Genji wanted to avoid troubling the officials and the people, so he tried to keep every arrangement as simple as possible.

units.source_text: 但因身居准太上天皇之位，排场自然异常盛大。

en.t: But because he held a rank equivalent to that of a retired emperor, the scale of the procession naturally became extraordinarily grand.

units.source_text: 大员之中，除左右二大臣之外，其余全部参与。

en.t: Among the high officials, all took part except for the two ministers of the left and right.

units.source_text: 舞人从卫府次官中选用，相貌个个俊美，身材一律等高。

en.t: The dancers were chosen from among the assistant officers of the guard, and every one of them was handsome, with their heights all evenly matched.

units.source_text: 不能入选之人，引以为耻，有几个爱出风头的人竟不胜悲伤。

en.t: Those who were not selected regarded it as a disgrace, and several men who liked to stand out were even overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 乐人则从石清水、贺茂等临时祭所用的人中选择才能特别优越者，组成一班。

en.t: The musicians were formed into a group by selecting the most exceptionally talented performers from among those used for the special festivals at Iwashimizu, Kamo, and other shrines.

units.source_text: 又外加二人，都是近卫府中大名鼎鼎的能手。

en.t: Two more men were added as well, both of them renowned masters from the Palace Guards.

units.source_text: 神乐方面，也选用许多人员。

en.t: For the sacred kagura performances too, many people were selected.

units.source_text: 新皇帝、皇太子、冷泉院，都派殿上人前来，分别为源氏服务。

en.t: The new emperor, the crown prince, and Reizei-in all sent courtiers to attend Genji on their behalf.

units.source_text: 多不胜数的高官贵族的马鞍、马副、随从、近侍童子等，都装饰得绚丽灿烂，其美无比。

en.t: The saddles, grooms, attendants, young pages, and other retinues of the countless high officials and nobles were all decorated in dazzling splendor, and their beauty was beyond compare.
